passages.label: Mart. 5.1.1
passages.text: Hoc tibi, Palladiae seu collibus uteris Albae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.2
passages.text: Caesar, et hinc Triviam prospicis, inde Thetin,

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.3
passages.text: Seu tua veridicae discunt responsa sorores,

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.4
passages.text: Plana suburbani qua cubat unda freti,

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.5
passages.text: Seu placet Aeneae nutrix, seu filia Solis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.6
passages.text: Sive salutiferis candidus Anxur aquis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.7
passages.text: Mittimus, o rerum felix tutela salusque,

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.8
passages.text: Sospite quo gratum credimus esse Iovem.

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.9
passages.text: Tu tantum accipias: ego te legisse putabo

passages.label: Mart. 5.1.10
passages.text: Et tumidus Galla credulitate fruar.

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.1
passages.text: Matronae puerique virginesque,

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.2
passages.text: Vobis pagina nostra dedicatur.

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.3
passages.text: Tu, quem nequitiae procaciores

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.4
passages.text: Delectant nimium salesque nudi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.5
passages.text: Lascivos lege quattuor libellos:

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.6
passages.text: Quintus cum domino liber iocatur;

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.7
passages.text: Quem Germanicus ore non rubenti

passages.label: Mart. 5.2.8
passages.text: Coram Cecropia legat puella.

passages.label: Mart. 5.3.1
passages.text: Accola iam nostrae Degis, Germanice, ripae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.3.2
passages.text: A famulis Histri qui tibi venit aquis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.3.3
passages.text: Laetus et attonitus viso modo praeside mundi

passages.label: Mart. 5.3.4
passages.text: Adfatus comites dicitur esse suos:

passages.label: Mart. 5.3.5
passages.text: 'Sors mea quam fratris melior, cui tam prope fas est

passages.label: Mart. 5.3.6
passages.text: Cernere, tam longe quem colit ille deum.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.4.1
passages.text: Fetere multo Myrtale solet vino,

passages.label: Mart. 5.4.2
passages.text: Sed fallat ut nos, folia devorat lauri

passages.label: Mart. 5.4.3
passages.text: Merumque cauta fronde, non aqua miscet.

passages.label: Mart. 5.4.4
passages.text: Hanc tu rubentem prominentibus venis

passages.label: Mart. 5.4.5
passages.text: Quotiens venire, Paule, videris contra,

passages.label: Mart. 5.4.6
passages.text: Dicas licebit 'Myrtale bibit laurum.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.1
passages.text: Sexte, Palatinae cultor facunde Minervae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.2
passages.text: Ingenio frueris qui propiore dei—

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.3
passages.text: Nam tibi nascentes domini cognoscere curas

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.4
passages.text: Et secreta ducis pectora nosse licet—:

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.5
passages.text: Sit locus et nostris aliqua tibi parte libellis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.6
passages.text: Qua Pedo, qua Marsus quaque Catullus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.7
passages.text: Ad Capitolini caelestia carmina belli

passages.label: Mart. 5.5.8
passages.text: Grande coturnati pone Maronis opus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.1
passages.text: Si non est grave nec nimis molestum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.2
passages.text: Musae, Parthenium rogate vestrum:

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.3
passages.text: Sic te serior et beata quondam

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.4
passages.text: Salvo Caesare finiat senectus

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.5
passages.text: Et sis invidia favente felix,

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.6
passages.text: Sic Burrus cito sentiat parentem:

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.7
passages.text: Admittas timidam brevemque chartam

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.8
passages.text: Intra limina sanctioris aulae.

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.9
passages.text: Nosti tempora tu Iovis sereni,

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.10
passages.text: Cum fulget placido suoque vultu,

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.11
passages.text: Quo nil supplicibus solet negare.

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.12
passages.text: Non est quod metuas preces iniquas:

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.13
passages.text: Numquam grandia nec molesta poscit

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.14
passages.text: Quae cedro decorata purpuraque

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.15
passages.text: Nigris pagina crevit umbilicis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.16
passages.text: Nec porrexeris ista, sed teneto

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.17
passages.text: Sic tamquam nihil offeras agasque.

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.18
passages.text: Si novi dominum novem sororum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.6.19
passages.text: Ultro purpureum petet libellum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.1
passages.text: Qualiter Assyrios renovant incendia nidos,

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.2
passages.text: Una decem quotiens saecula vixit avis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.3
passages.text: Taliter exuta est veterem nova Roma senectam

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.4
passages.text: Et sumpsit vultus praesidis ipsa sui.

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.5
passages.text: Iam precor oblitus notae Vulcane, querellae

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.6
passages.text: Parce: sumus Martis turba, sed et Veneris:

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.7
passages.text: Parce, pater: sic Lemniacis lasciva catenis

passages.label: Mart. 5.7.8
passages.text: Ignoscat coniunx et patienter amet.

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.1
passages.text: Edictum domini deique nostri,

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.2
passages.text: Quo subsellia certiora fiunt

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.3
passages.text: Et puros eques ordines recepit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.4
passages.text: Dum laudat modo Phasis in theatro,

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.5
passages.text: Phasis purpureis ruber lacernis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.6
passages.text: Et iactat tumido superbus ore:

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.7
passages.text: 'Tandem commodius licet sedere,

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.8
passages.text: Nunc est reddita dignitas equestris,

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.9
passages.text: Turba non premimur nec inquinamur':

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.10
passages.text: Haec et talia dum refert supinus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.11
passages.text: Illas purpureas et adrogantes

passages.label: Mart. 5.8.12
passages.text: Iussit surgere Lei+tus lacernas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.9.1
passages.text: Languebam: sed tu comitatus protinus ad me

passages.label: Mart. 5.9.2
passages.text: Venisti centum, Symmache, discipulis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.9.3
passages.text: Centum me tetigere manus aquilone gelatae:

passages.label: Mart. 5.9.4
passages.text: Non habui febrem, Symmache, nunc habeo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.1
passages.text: 'Esse quid hoc dicam, vivis quod fama negatur

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.2
passages.text: Et sua quod rarus tempora lector amat?'

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.3
passages.text: Hi sunt invidiae nimirum, Regule, mores,

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.4
passages.text: Praeferat antiquos semper ut illa novis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.5
passages.text: Sic veterem ingrati Pompei quaerimus umbram,

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.6
passages.text: Sic laudant Catuli vilia templa senes;

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.7
passages.text: Ennius est lectus salvo tibi, Roma, Marone,

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.8
passages.text: Et sua riserunt saecula Maeoniden,

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.9
passages.text: Rara coronato plausere theatra Menandro,

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.10
passages.text: Norat Nasonem sola Corinna suum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.11
passages.text: Vos tamen o nostri ne festinate libelli:

passages.label: Mart. 5.10.12
passages.text: Si post fata venit gloria, non propero.

passages.label: Mart. 5.11.1
passages.text: Sardonychas, zmaragdos, adamantas, iaspidas uno

passages.label: Mart. 5.11.2
passages.text: Versat in articulo Stella, Severe, meus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.11.3
passages.text: Multas in digitis, plures in carmine gemmas

passages.label: Mart. 5.11.4
passages.text: Invenies: inde est haec, puto, culta manus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.12.1
passages.text: Quod nutantia fronte perticata

passages.label: Mart. 5.12.2
passages.text: Gestat pondera Masclion superbus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.12.3
passages.text: Aut grandis Ninus omnibus lacertis

passages.label: Mart. 5.12.4
passages.text: Septem quod pueros levat vel octo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.12.5
passages.text: Res non difficilis mihi videtur,

passages.label: Mart. 5.12.6
passages.text: Uno cum digito vel hoc vel illo

passages.label: Mart. 5.12.7
passages.text: Portet Stella meus decem puellas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.1
passages.text: Sum, fateor, semperque fui, Callistrate, pauper,

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.2
passages.text: Sed non obscurus nec male notus eques,

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.3
passages.text: Sed toto legor orbe frequens et dicitur 'Hic est',

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.4
passages.text: Quodque cinis paucis, hoc mihi vita dedit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.5
passages.text: At tua centenis incumbunt tecta columnis

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.6
passages.text: Et libertinas arca flagellat opes,

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.7
passages.text: Magnaque Niliacae servit tibi glaeba Syenes,

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.8
passages.text: Tondet et innumeros Gallica Parma greges.

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.9
passages.text: Hoc ego tuque sumus: sed quod sum, non potes esse:

passages.label: Mart. 5.13.10
passages.text: Tu quod es, e populo quilibet esse potest.

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.1
passages.text: Sedere primo solitus in gradu semper

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.2
passages.text: Tunc, cum liceret occupare, Nanneius

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.3
passages.text: Bis excitatus terque transtulit castra,

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.4
passages.text: Et inter ipsas paene tertius sellas

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.5
passages.text: Post Gaiumque Luciumque consedit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.6
passages.text: Illinc cucullo prospicit caput tectus

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.7
passages.text: Oculoque ludos spectat indecens uno.

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.8
passages.text: Et hinc miser deiectus in viam transit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.9
passages.text: Subsellioque semifultus extremo

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.10
passages.text: Et male receptus altero genu iactat

passages.label: Mart. 5.14.11
passages.text: Equiti sedere Lei+toque se stare.

passages.label: Mart. 5.15.1
passages.text: Quintus nostrorum liber est, Auguste, iocorum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.15.2
passages.text: Et queritur laesus carmine nemo meo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.15.3
passages.text: Gaudet honorato sed multus nomine lector,

passages.label: Mart. 5.15.4
passages.text: Cui victura meo munere fama datur.

passages.label: Mart. 5.15.5
passages.text: 'Quid tamen haec prosunt quamvis venerantia multos?'

passages.label: Mart. 5.15.6
passages.text: Non prosint sane, me tamen ista iuvant.

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.1
passages.text: Seria cum possim, quod delectantia malo

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.2
passages.text: Scribere, tu causa es, lector amice, mihi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.3
passages.text: Qui legis et tota cantas mea carmina Roma:

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.4
passages.text: Sed nescis, quanti stet mihi talis amor.

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.5
passages.text: Nam si falciferi defendere templa Tonantis

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.6
passages.text: Sollicitisque velim vendere verba reis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.7
passages.text: Plurimus Hispanas mittet mihi nauta metretas

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.8
passages.text: Et fiet vario sordidus aere sinus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.9
passages.text: At nunc conviva est comissatorque libellus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.10
passages.text: Et tantum gratis pagina nostra placet.

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.11
passages.text: Sed non et veteres contenti laude fuerunt,

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.12
passages.text: Cum minimum vati munus Alexis erat.

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.13
passages.text: 'Belle' inquis 'dixti: iuvat et laudabimus usque.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.16.14
passages.text: Dissimulas? facies me, puto, causidicum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.17.1
passages.text: Dum proavos atavosque refers et nomina magna,

passages.label: Mart. 5.17.2
passages.text: Dum tibi noster eques sordida condicio est,

passages.label: Mart. 5.17.3
passages.text: Dum te posse negas nisi lato, Gellia, clavo

passages.label: Mart. 5.17.4
passages.text: Nubere, nupsisti, Gellia, cistibero.

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.1
passages.text: Quod tibi Decembri mense, quo volant mappae

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.2
passages.text: Gracilesque ligulae cereique chartaeque

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.3
passages.text: Et acuta senibus testa cum Damascenis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.4
passages.text: Praeter libellos vernulas nihil misi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.5
passages.text: Fortasse avarus videar aut inhumanus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.6
passages.text: Odi dolosas munerum et malas artes:

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.7
passages.text: Imitantur hamos dona: namque quis nescit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.8
passages.text: Avidum vorata decipi scarum musca?

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.9
passages.text: Quotiens amico diviti nihil donat,

passages.label: Mart. 5.18.10
passages.text: O Quintiane, liberalis est pauper.

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.1
passages.text: Si qua fides veris, praeferri, maxime Caesar,

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.2
passages.text: Temporibus possunt saecula nulla tuis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.3
passages.text: Quando magis dignos licuit spectare triumphos?

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.4
passages.text: Quando Palatini plus meruere dei?

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.5
passages.text: Pulchrior et maior quo sub duce Martia Roma?

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.6
passages.text: Sub quo libertas principe tanta fuit?

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.7
passages.text: Est tamen hoc vitium, sed non leve, sit licet unum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.8
passages.text: Quod colit ingratas pauper amicitias.

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.9
passages.text: Quis largitur opes veteri fidoque sodali,

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.10
passages.text: Aut quem prosequitur non alienus eques?

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.11
passages.text: Saturnaliciae ligulam misisse selibrae

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.12
passages.text: Flammarisve togae scripula tota decem

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.13
passages.text: Luxuria est, tumidique vocant haec munera reges:

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.14
passages.text: Qui crepet aureolos, forsitan unus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.15
passages.text: Quatenus hi non sunt, esto tu, Caesar, amicus:

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.16
passages.text: Nulla ducis virtus dulcior esse potest.

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.17
passages.text: Iam dudum tacito rides, Germanice, naso,

passages.label: Mart. 5.19.18
passages.text: Utile quod nobis do tibi consilium.

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.1
passages.text: Si tecum mihi, care Martialis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.2
passages.text: Securis liceat frui diebus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.3
passages.text: Si disponere tempus otiosum

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.4
passages.text: Et verae pariter vacare vitae:

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.5
passages.text: Nec nos atria, nec domos potentum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.6
passages.text: Nec litis tetricas forumque triste

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.7
passages.text: Nossemus, nec imagines superbas;

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.8
passages.text: Sed gestatio, fabulae, libelli,

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.9
passages.text: Campus, porticus, umbra, Virgo, thermae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.10
passages.text: Haec essent loca semper, hi labores.

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.11
passages.text: Nunc vivit necuter sibi, bonosque

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.12
passages.text: Soles effugere atque abire sentit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.13
passages.text: Qui nobis pereunt et inputantur.

passages.label: Mart. 5.20.14
passages.text: Quisquam vivere cum sciat, moratur?

passages.label: Mart. 5.21.1
passages.text: Quintum pro Decimo, pro Crasso, Regule, Macrum

passages.label: Mart. 5.21.2
passages.text: Ante salutabat rhetor Apollodotus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.21.3
passages.text: Nunc utrumque suo resalutat nomine. Quantum

passages.label: Mart. 5.21.4
passages.text: Cura laborque potest! Scripsit et edidicit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.1
passages.text: Mane domi nisi te volui meruique videre,

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.2
passages.text: Sint mihi, Paule, tuae longius Esquiliae.

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.3
passages.text: Sed Tiburtinae sum proximus accola pilae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.4
passages.text: Qua videt anticum rustica Flora Iovem:

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.5
passages.text: Alta Suburani vincenda est semita clivi

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.6
passages.text: Et numquam sicco sordida saxa gradu,

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.7
passages.text: Vixque datur longas mulorum rumpere mandras

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.8
passages.text: Quaeque trahi multo marmora fune vides.

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.9
passages.text: Illud adhuc gravius, quod te post mille labores,

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.10
passages.text: Paule, negat lasso ianitor esse domi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.11
passages.text: Exitus hic operis vani togulaeque madentis:

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.12
passages.text: Vix tanti Paulum mane videre fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.13
passages.text: Semper inhumanos habet officiosus amicos:

passages.label: Mart. 5.22.14
passages.text: Rex, nisi dormieris, non potes esse meus.

passages.text: Herbarum fueras indutus, Basse, colores,

passages.text: Quae postquam placidi censoris cura renasci

passages.text: Iussit et Oceanum certior audit eques,

passages.text: Non nisi vel cocco madida vel murice tincta

passages.label: Mart. 5.23.6
passages.text: Veste nites et te sic dare verba putas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.23.7
passages.text: Quadringentorum nullae sunt, Basse, lacernae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.23.8
passages.text: Aut meus ante omnis Cordus haberet equum.

passages.text: Lei+tus ecce venit: sta, fuge, curre, late.'

passages.text: Ecquis, io, revocat discedentemque reducit?

passages.text: Ecquis, io, largas pandit amicus opes?

passages.text: Quem chartis famaeque damus populisque loquendum?

passages.label: Mart. 5.25.7
passages.text: Hoc, rogo, non melius, quam rubro pulpita nimbo

passages.label: Mart. 5.25.8
passages.text: Spargere et effuso permaduisse croco?

passages.label: Mart. 5.25.9
passages.text: Quam non sensuro dare quadringenta caballo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.25.10
passages.text: Aureus ut Scorpi nasus ubique micet?

passages.label: Mart. 5.25.11
passages.text: O frustra locuples, o dissimulator amici,

passages.label: Mart. 5.25.12
passages.text: Haec legis et laudas? Quae tibi fama perit!

passages.label: Mart. 5.26.1
passages.text: Quod alpha dixi, Corde, paenulatorum

passages.label: Mart. 5.26.2
passages.text: Te nuper, aliqua cum iocarer in charta,

passages.label: Mart. 5.26.3
passages.text: Si forte bilem movit hic tibi versus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.26.4
passages.text: Dicas licebit beta me togatorum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.27.1
passages.text: Ingenium studiumque tibi moresque genusque

passages.label: Mart. 5.27.2
passages.text: Sunt equitis, fateor: cetera plebis habes.

passages.label: Mart. 5.27.3
passages.text: Bis septena tibi non sint subsellia tanti,

passages.label: Mart. 5.27.4
passages.text: Ut sedeas viso pallidus Oceano.

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.1
passages.text: Ut bene loquatur sentiatque Mamercus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.2
passages.text: Efficere nullis, Aule, moribus possis:

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.3
passages.text: Pietate fratres Curvios licet vincas,

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.4
passages.text: Quiete Nervas, comitate Rusones,

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.5
passages.text: Probitate Macros, aequitate Mauricos,

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.6
passages.text: Oratione Regulos, iocis Paulos:

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.7
passages.text: Robiginosis cuncta dentibus rodit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.8
passages.text: Hominem malignum forsan esse tu credas:

passages.label: Mart. 5.28.9
passages.text: Ego esse miserum credo, cui placet nemo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.29.1
passages.text: Si quando leporem mittis mihi, Gellia, dicis:

passages.label: Mart. 5.29.2
passages.text: 'Formosus septem, Marce, diebus eris.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.29.3
passages.text: Si non derides, si verum, lux mea, narras,

passages.label: Mart. 5.29.4
passages.text: Edisti numquam, Gellia, tu leporem.

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.1
passages.text: Varro, Sophocleo non infitiande coturno,

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.2
passages.text: Nec minus in Calabra suspiciende lyra,

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.3
passages.text: Differ opus, nec te facundi scaena Catulli

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.4
passages.text: Detineat, cultis aut elegia comis;

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.5
passages.text: Sed lege fumoso non aspernanda Decembri

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.6
passages.text: Carmina, mittuntur quae tibi mense suo:

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.7
passages.text: Commodius nisi forte tibi potiusque videtur,

passages.label: Mart. 5.30.8
passages.text: Saturnalicias perdere, Varro, nuces.

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.1
passages.text: Aspice, quam placidis insultet turba iuvencis

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.2
passages.text: Et sua quam facilis pondera taurus amet.

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.3
passages.text: Cornibus hic pendet summis, vagus ille per armos

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.4
passages.text: Currit et in toto ventilat arma bove.

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.5
passages.text: At feritas inmota riget: non esset harena

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.6
passages.text: Tutior, et poterant fallere plana magis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.7
passages.text: Nec trepidant gestus, sed de discrimine palmae

passages.label: Mart. 5.31.8
passages.text: Securus puer est, sollicitumque pecus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.32.1
passages.text: Quadrantem Crispus tabulis, Faustine, supremis

passages.label: Mart. 5.32.2
passages.text: Non dedit uxori. 'Cui dedit ergo?' Sibi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.33.1
passages.text: Carpere causidicus fertur mea carmina: qui sit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.33.2
passages.text: Nescio: si sciero, vae tibi, causidice.

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.1
passages.text: Hanc tibi, Fronto pater, genetrix Flaccilla, puellam

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.2
passages.text: Oscula commendo deliciasque meas,

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.3
passages.text: Parvola ne nigras horrescat Erotion umbras

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.4
passages.text: Oraque Tartarei prodigiosa canis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.5
passages.text: Inpletura fuit sextae modo frigora brumae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.6
passages.text: Vixisset totidem ni minus illa dies.

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.7
passages.text: Inter tam veteres ludat lasciva patronos

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.8
passages.text: Et nomen blaeso garriat ore meum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.9
passages.text: Mollia non rigidus caespes tegat ossa, nec illi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.34.10
passages.text: Terra, gravis fueris: non fuit illa tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.1
passages.text: Dum sibi redire de Patrensibus fundis

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.2
passages.text: Ducena clamat coccinatus Euclides

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.3
passages.text: Corinthioque plura de suburbano

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.4
passages.text: Longumque pulchra stemma repetit a Leda

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.5
passages.text: Et suscitanti Leito reluctatur:

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.6
passages.text: Equiti superbo, nobili, locupleti

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.7
passages.text: Cecidit repente magna de sinu clavis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.35.8
passages.text: Numquam, Fabulle, nequior fuit clavis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.36.1
passages.text: Laudatus nostro quidam, Faustine, libello

passages.label: Mart. 5.36.2
passages.text: Dissimulat, quasi nil debeat: inposuit

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.1
passages.text: Puella senibus dulcior mihi cycnis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.2
passages.text: Agna Galaesi mollior Phalantini,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.3
passages.text: Concha Lucrini delicatior stagni,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.4
passages.text: Cui nec lapillos praeferas Erythraeos,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.5
passages.text: Nec modo politum pecudis Indicae dentem

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.6
passages.text: Nivesque primas liliumque non tactum;

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.7
passages.text: Quae crine vicit Baetici gregis vellus

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.8
passages.text: Rhenique nodos aureamque nitelam;

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.9
passages.text: Fragravit ore, quod rosarium Paesti,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.10
passages.text: Quod Atticarum prima mella cerarum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.11
passages.text: Quod sucinorum rapta de manu glaeba;

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.12
passages.text: Cui conparatus indecens erat pavo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.13
passages.text: Inamabilis sciurus et frequens phoenix:

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.14
passages.text: Adhuc recenti tepet Erotion busto,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.15
passages.text: Quam pessimorum lex amara fatorum

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.16
passages.text: Sexta peregit hieme, nec tamen tota,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.17
passages.text: Nostros amores gaudiumque lususque—

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.18
passages.text: Et esse tristem me meus vetat Paetus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.19
passages.text: Pectusque pulsans pariter et comam vellens:

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.20
passages.text: 'Deflere non te vernulae pudet mortem?

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.21
passages.text: Ego coniugem' inquit 'extuli, et tamen vivo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.22
passages.text: Notam, superbam, nobilem, locupletem.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.23
passages.text: Quid esse nostro fortius potest Paeto?

passages.label: Mart. 5.37.24
passages.text: Ducentiens accepit, et tamen vivit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.1
passages.text: Calliodorus habet censum—quis nescit?—equestrem,

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.2
passages.text: Sexte, sed et fratrem Calliodorus habet.

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.3
passages.text: 'Quadringenta seca' qui dicit σῦκα μερίζει:

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.4
passages.text: Uno credis equo posse sedere duos?

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.5
passages.text: Quid cum fratre tibi, quid cum Polluce molesto?

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.6
passages.text: Non esset Pollux si tibi, Castor eras.

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.7
passages.text: Unus cum sitis, duo, Calliodore, sedebis?

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.8
passages.text: Surge: σολοικισμὸν, Calliodore, facis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.9
passages.text: Aut imitare genus Ledae—cum fratre sedere

passages.label: Mart. 5.38.10
passages.text: Non potes—: alternis, Calliodore, sede.

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.1
passages.text: Supremas tibi triciens in anno

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.2
passages.text: Signanti tabulas, Charine, misi

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.3
passages.text: Hyblaeis madidas thymis placentas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.4
passages.text: Defeci: miserere iam, Charine:

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.5
passages.text: Signa rarius, aut semel fac illud,

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.6
passages.text: Mentitur tua quod subinde tussis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.7
passages.text: Excussi loculosque sacculumque:

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.8
passages.text: Croeso divitior licet fuissem,

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.9
passages.text: Iro pauperior forem, Charine,

passages.label: Mart. 5.39.10
passages.text: Si conchem totiens meam comesses.

passages.label: Mart. 5.40.1
passages.text: Pinxisti Venerem, colis, Artemidore, Minervam:

passages.label: Mart. 5.40.2
passages.text: Et miraris, opus displicuisse tuum?

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.1
passages.text: Spadone cum sis eviratior fluxo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.2
passages.text: Et concubino mollior Celaenaeo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.3
passages.text: Quem sectus ululat matris entheae Gallus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.4
passages.text: Theatra loqueris et gradus et edicta,

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.5
passages.text: Trabeasque et Idus fibulasque censusque,

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.6
passages.text: Et pumicata pauperes manu monstras.

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.7
passages.text: Sedere in equitum liceat an tibi scamnis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.41.8
passages.text: Videbo, Didyme: non licet maritorum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.1
passages.text: Callidus effracta nummos fur auferet arca,

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.2
passages.text: Prosternet patrios impia flamma lares:

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.3
passages.text: Debitor usuram pariter sortemque negabit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.4
passages.text: Non reddet sterilis semina iacta seges:

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.5
passages.text: Dispensatorem fallax spoliabit amica,

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.6
passages.text: Mercibus extructas obruet unda rates.

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.7
passages.text: Extra fortunam est, quidquid donatur amicis:

passages.label: Mart. 5.42.8
passages.text: Quas dederis, solas semper habebis opes.

passages.label: Mart. 5.43.1
passages.text: Thais habet nigros, niveos Laecania dentes.

passages.label: Mart. 5.43.2
passages.text: Quae ratio est? Emptos haec habet, illa suos.

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.1
passages.text: Quid factum est, rogo, quid repente factum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.2
passages.text: Ad cenam mihi, Dento, quod vocanti—

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.3
passages.text: Quis credat?—quater ausus es negare?

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.4
passages.text: Sed nec respicis et fugis sequentem,

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.5
passages.text: Quem thermis modo quaerere et theatris

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.6
passages.text: Et conclavibus omnibus solebas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.7
passages.text: Sic est, captus es unctiore mensa

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.8
passages.text: Et maior rapuit canem culina.

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.9
passages.text: Iam te, sed cito, cognitum et relictum

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.10
passages.text: Cum fastidierit popina dives,

passages.label: Mart. 5.44.11
passages.text: Antiquae venies ad ossa cenae.

passages.label: Mart. 5.45.1
passages.text: Dicis formosam, dicis te, Bassa, puellam.

passages.label: Mart. 5.45.2
passages.text: Istud quae non est dicere, Bassa, solet.

passages.label: Mart. 5.46.1
passages.text: Basia dum nolo nisi quae luctantia carpsi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.46.2
passages.text: Et placet ira mihi plus tua, quam facies,

passages.label: Mart. 5.46.3
passages.text: Ut te saepe rogem, caedo, Diadumene, saepe:

passages.label: Mart. 5.46.4
passages.text: Consequor hoc, ut me nec timeas nec ames.

passages.label: Mart. 5.47.1
passages.text: Numquam se cenasse domi Philo iurat, et hoc est:

passages.label: Mart. 5.47.2
passages.text: Non cenat, quotiens nemo vocavit eum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.1
passages.text: Quid non cogit amor? secuit nolente capillos

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.2
passages.text: Encolpos domino, non prohibente tamen.

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.3
passages.text: Permisit flevitque Pudens: sic cessit habenis

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.4
passages.text: Audaci questus de Phaethonte pater:

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.5
passages.text: Talis raptus Hylas, talis deprensus Achilles

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.6
passages.text: Deposuit gaudens, matre dolente, comas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.7
passages.text: Sed tu ne propera—brevibus ne crede capillis—

passages.label: Mart. 5.48.8
passages.text: Tardaque pro tanto munere, barba, veni.

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.1
passages.text: Vidissem modo forte cum sedentem

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.2
passages.text: Solum te, Labiene, tres putavi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.3
passages.text: Calvae me numerus tuae fefellit:

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.4
passages.text: Sunt illinc tibi, sunt et hinc capilli,

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.5
passages.text: Quales vel puerum decere possunt;

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.6
passages.text: Nudumst in medio caput, nec ullus

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.7
passages.text: In longa pilus area notatur.

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.8
passages.text: Hic error tibi profuit Decembri,

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.9
passages.text: Tum, cum prandia misit Imperator:

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.10
passages.text: Cum panariolis tribus redisti.

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.11
passages.text: Talem Geryonem fuisse credo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.12
passages.text: Vites, censeo, porticum Philippi:

passages.label: Mart. 5.49.13
passages.text: Si te viderit Hercules, peristi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.1
passages.text: Ceno domi quotiens, nisi te, Charopine, vocavi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.2
passages.text: Protinus ingentes sunt inimicitiae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.3
passages.text: Meque potes stricto medium transfigere ferro,

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.4
passages.text: Si nostrum sine te scis caluisse focum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.5
passages.text: Nec semel ergo mihi furtum fecisse licebit?

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.6
passages.text: Inprobius nihil est hac, Charopine, gula.

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.7
passages.text: Desine iam nostram, precor, observare culinam,

passages.label: Mart. 5.50.8
passages.text: Atque aliquando meus det tibi verba cocus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.1
passages.text: Hic, qui libellis praegravem gerit laevam,

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.2
passages.text: Notariorum quem premit chorus levis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.3
passages.text: Qui codicillis hinc et inde prolatis

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.4
passages.text: Epistulisque commodat gravem voltum

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.5
passages.text: Similis Catoni Tullioque Brutoque,

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.6
passages.text: Exprimere, Rufe, fidiculae licet cogant,

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.7
passages.text: Have Latinum, χαῖρε non potest Graecum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.51.8
passages.text: Si fingere istud me putas, salutemus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.1
passages.text: Quae mihi praestiteris memini semperque tenebo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.2
passages.text: Cur igitur taceo, Postume? Tu loqueris.

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.3
passages.text: Incipio quotiens alicui tua dona referre,

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.4
passages.text: Protinus exclamat 'Dixerat ipse mihi.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.5
passages.text: Non belle quaedam faciunt duo: sufficit unus

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.6
passages.text: Huic operi: si vis, ut loquar, ipse tace.

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.7
passages.text: Crede mihi, quamvis ingentia, Postume, dona

passages.label: Mart. 5.52.8
passages.text: Auctoris pereunt garrulitate sui.

passages.label: Mart. 5.53.1
passages.text: Colchida quid scribis, quid scribis, amice, Thyesten?

passages.label: Mart. 5.53.2
passages.text: Quo tibi vel Nioben, Basse, vel Andromachen?

passages.label: Mart. 5.53.3
passages.text: Materia est, mihi crede, tuis aptissima chartis

passages.label: Mart. 5.53.4
passages.text: Deucalion vel, si non placet hic, Phaethon.

passages.label: Mart. 5.54.1
passages.text: Extemporalis factus est meus rhetor:

passages.label: Mart. 5.54.2
passages.text: Calpurnium non scripsit, et salutavit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.55.1
passages.text: Dic mihi, quem portas, volucrum regina? 'Tonantem.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.55.2
passages.text: Nulla manu quare fulmina gestat? 'Amat.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.55.3
passages.text: Quo calet igne deus? 'Pueri.' Cur mitis aperto

passages.label: Mart. 5.55.4
passages.text: Respicis ore Iovem? 'De Ganymede loquor.'

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.1
passages.text: Cui tradas, Lupe, filium magistro,

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.2
passages.text: Quaeris sollicitus diu rogasque.

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.3
passages.text: Omnes grammaticosque rhetorasque

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.4
passages.text: Devites, moneo: nihil sit illi

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.5
passages.text: Cum libris Ciceronis aut Maronis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.6
passages.text: Famae Tutilium suae relinquat;

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.7
passages.text: Si versus facit, abdices poetam.

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.8
passages.text: Artes discere vult pecuniosas?

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.9
passages.text: Fac discat citharoedus aut choraules;

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.10
passages.text: Si duri puer ingeni videtur,

passages.label: Mart. 5.56.11
passages.text: Praeconem facias vel architectum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.57.1
passages.text: Cum voco te dominum, noli tibi, Cinna, placere:

passages.label: Mart. 5.57.2
passages.text: Saepe etiam servum sic resaluto tuum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.1
passages.text: Cras te victurum, cras dicis, Postume, semper.

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.2
passages.text: Dic mihi, cras istud, Postume, quando venit?

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.3
passages.text: Quam longe cras istud, ubi est? aut unde petendum?

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.4
passages.text: Numquid apud Parthos Armeniosque latet?

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.5
passages.text: Iam cras istud habet Priami vel Nestoris annos.

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.6
passages.text: Cras istud quanti, dic mihi, possit emi?

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.7
passages.text: Cras vives? hodie iam vivere, Postume, serum est:

passages.label: Mart. 5.58.8
passages.text: Ille sapit, quisquis, Postume, vixit heri.

passages.label: Mart. 5.59.1
passages.text: Quod non argentum, quod non tibi mittimus aurum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.59.2
passages.text: Hoc facimus causa, Stella diserte, tua.

passages.label: Mart. 5.59.3
passages.text: Quisquis magna dedit, voluit sibi magna remitti;

passages.label: Mart. 5.59.4
passages.text: Fictilibus nostris exoneratus eris.

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.1
passages.text: Adlatres licet usque nos et usque

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.2
passages.text: Et gannitibus inprobis lacessas,

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.3
passages.text: Certum est hanc tibi pernegare famam,

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.4
passages.text: Olim quam petis, in meis libellis

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.5
passages.text: Qualiscumque legaris ut per orbem.

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.6
passages.text: Nam te cur aliquis sciat fuisse?

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.7
passages.text: Ignotus pereas, miser, necesse est.

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.8
passages.text: Non deerunt tamen hac in urbe forsan

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.9
passages.text: Unus vel duo tresve quattuorve,

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.10
passages.text: Pellem rodere qui velint caninam:

passages.label: Mart. 5.60.11
passages.text: Nos hac a scabie tenemus ungues.

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.1
passages.text: Crispulus iste quis est, uxori semper adhaeret

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.2
passages.text: Qui, Mariane, tuae? crispulus iste quis est?

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.3
passages.text: Nescio quid dominae teneram qui garrit in aurem

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.4
passages.text: Et sellam cubito dexteriore premit?

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.5
passages.text: Per cuius digitos currit levis anulus omnes,

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.6
passages.text: Crura gerit nullo qui violata pilo?

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.7
passages.text: Nil mihi respondes? 'Uxoris res agit' inquis

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.8
passages.text: 'Iste meae.' Sane certus et asper homo est,

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.9
passages.text: Procuratorem voltu qui praeferat ipso:

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.10
passages.text: Acrior hoc Chius non erit Aufidius.

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.11
passages.text: O quam dignus eras alapis, Mariane, Latini:

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.12
passages.text: Te successurum credo ego Panniculo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.13
passages.text: Res uxoris agit? res ullas crispulus iste?

passages.label: Mart. 5.61.14
passages.text: Res non uxoris, res agit iste tuas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.1
passages.text: Iure tuo nostris maneas licet, hospes, in hortis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.2
passages.text: Si potes in nudo ponere membra solo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.3
passages.text: Aut si portatur tecum tibi magna supellex:

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.4
passages.text: Nam mea iam digitum sustulit hospitibus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.5
passages.text: Nulla tegit fractos—nec inanis—culcita lectos,

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.6
passages.text: Putris et abrupta fascia reste iacet.

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.7
passages.text: Sit tamen hospitium nobis commune duobus:

passages.label: Mart. 5.62.8
passages.text: Emi hortos; plus est: instrue tu; minus est.

passages.label: Mart. 5.63.1
passages.text: 'Quid sentis' inquis 'de nostris, Marce, libellis?'

passages.label: Mart. 5.63.2
passages.text: Sic me sollicitus, Pontice, saepe rogas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.63.3
passages.text: Admiror, stupeo: nihil est perfectius illis,

passages.label: Mart. 5.63.4
passages.text: Ipse tuo cedet Regulus ingenio.

passages.label: Mart. 5.63.5
passages.text: 'Hoc sentis?' inquis 'faciat tibi sic bene Caesar,

passages.label: Mart. 5.63.6
passages.text: Sic Capitolinus Iuppiter.' Immo tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.64.1
passages.text: Sextantes, Calliste, duos infunde Falerni,

passages.label: Mart. 5.64.2
passages.text: Tu super aestivas, Alcime, solve nives,

passages.label: Mart. 5.64.3
passages.text: Pinguescat nimio madidus mihi crinis amomo

passages.label: Mart. 5.64.4
passages.text: Lassenturque rosis tempora sutilibus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.64.5
passages.text: Tam vicina iubent nos vivere Mausolea,

passages.label: Mart. 5.64.6
passages.text: Cum doceant, ipsos posse perire deos.

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.1
passages.text: Astra polumque dedit, quamvis obstante noverca,

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.2
passages.text: Alcidae Nemees terror et Arcas aper

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.3
passages.text: Et castigatum Libycae ceroma palaestrae

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.4
passages.text: Et gravis in Siculo pulvere fusus Eryx,

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.5
passages.text: Silvarumque tremor, tacita qui fraude solebat

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.6
passages.text: Ducere non rectas Cacus in antra boves.

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.7
passages.text: Ista tuae, Caesar, quota pars spectatur harenae?

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.8
passages.text: Dat maiora novus proelia mane dies.

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.9
passages.text: Quot graviora cadunt Nemeaeo pondera monstro!

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.10
passages.text: Quot tua Maenalios conlocat hasta sues!

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.11
passages.text: Reddatur si pugna triplex pastoris Hiberi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.12
passages.text: Est tibi qui possit vincere Geryonen.

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.13
passages.text: Saepe licet Graiae numeretur belua Lernae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.14
passages.text: Inproba Niliacis quid facit Hydra feris?

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.15
passages.text: Pro meritis caelum tantis, Auguste, dederunt

passages.label: Mart. 5.65.16
passages.text: Alcidae cito di, sed tibi sero dabunt.

passages.label: Mart. 5.66.1
passages.text: Saepe salutatus numquam prior ipse salutas:

passages.label: Mart. 5.66.2
passages.text: Sic eris 'Aeternum', Pontiliane, 'vale'.

passages.label: Mart. 5.67.1
passages.text: Hibernos peterent solito cum more recessus

passages.label: Mart. 5.67.2
passages.text: Atthides, in nidis una remansit avis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.67.3
passages.text: Deprendere nefas ad tempora verna reversae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.67.4
passages.text: Et profugam volucres diripuere suae.

passages.label: Mart. 5.67.5
passages.text: Sero dedit poenas: discerpi noxia mater

passages.label: Mart. 5.67.6
passages.text: Debuerat, sed tunc, cum laceravit Ityn.

passages.label: Mart. 5.68.1
passages.text: Arctoa de gente comam tibi, Lesbia, misi,

passages.label: Mart. 5.68.2
passages.text: Ut scires, quanto sit tua flava magis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.1
passages.text: Antoni Phario nil obiecture Pothino

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.2
passages.text: Et levius tabula quam Cicerone nocens:

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.3
passages.text: Quid gladium demens Romana stringis in ora?

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.4
passages.text: Hoc admisisset nec Catilina nefas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.5
passages.text: Impius infando miles corrumpitur auro,

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.6
passages.text: Et tantis opibus vox tacet una tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.7
passages.text: Quid prosunt sacrae pretiosa silentia linguae?

passages.label: Mart. 5.69.8
passages.text: Incipient omnes pro Cicerone loqui.

passages.label: Mart. 5.70.1
passages.text: Infusum sibi nuper a patrono

passages.label: Mart. 5.70.2
passages.text: Plenum, Maxime, centiens Syriscus

passages.label: Mart. 5.70.3
passages.text: In sellariolis vagus popinis

passages.label: Mart. 5.70.4
passages.text: Circa balnea quattuor peregit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.70.5
passages.text: O quanta est gula, centiens comesse!

passages.label: Mart. 5.70.6
passages.text: Quanto maior adhuc, nec accubare!

passages.label: Mart. 5.71.1
passages.text: Umida qua gelidas summittit Trebula valles

passages.label: Mart. 5.71.2
passages.text: Et viridis cancri mensibus alget ager,

passages.label: Mart. 5.71.3
passages.text: Rura Cleonaeo numquam temerata leone

passages.label: Mart. 5.71.4
passages.text: Et domus Aeolio semper amica Noto,

passages.label: Mart. 5.71.5
passages.text: Te, Faustine, vocant: longas his exige messes

passages.label: Mart. 5.71.6
passages.text: Collibus; hibernum iam tibi Tibur erit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.72.1
passages.text: Qui potuit Bacchi matrem dixisse tonantem,

passages.label: Mart. 5.72.2
passages.text: Ille potest Semelen dicere, Rufe, patrem.

passages.label: Mart. 5.73.1
passages.text: Non donem tibi cur meos libellos

passages.label: Mart. 5.73.2
passages.text: Oranti totiens et exigenti,

passages.label: Mart. 5.73.3
passages.text: Miraris, Theodore? Magna causa est:

passages.label: Mart. 5.73.4
passages.text: Dones tu mihi ne tuos libellos.

passages.label: Mart. 5.74.1
passages.text: Pompeios iuvenes Asia atque Europa, sed ipsum

passages.label: Mart. 5.74.2
passages.text: Terra tegit Libyes, si tamen ulla tegit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.74.3
passages.text: Quid mirum toto si spargitur orbe? Iacere

passages.label: Mart. 5.74.4
passages.text: Uno non poterat tanta ruina loco.

passages.label: Mart. 5.75.1
passages.text: Quae legis causa nupsit tibi Laelia, Quinte,

passages.label: Mart. 5.75.2
passages.text: Uxorem potes hanc dicere legitimam.

passages.label: Mart. 5.76.1
passages.text: Profecit poto Mithridates saepe veneno,

passages.label: Mart. 5.76.2
passages.text: Toxica ne possent saeva nocere sibi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.76.3
passages.text: Tu quoque cavisti cenando tam male semper,

passages.label: Mart. 5.76.4
passages.text: Ne posses umquam, Cinna, perire fame.

passages.label: Mart. 5.77.1
passages.text: Narratur belle quidam dixisse, Marulle,

passages.label: Mart. 5.77.2
passages.text: Qui te ferre oleum dixit in auricula.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.1
passages.text: Si tristi domicenio laboras,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.2
passages.text: Torani, potes esurire mecum.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.3
passages.text: Non deerunt tibi, si soles προπίνειν,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.4
passages.text: Viles Cappadocae gravesque porri,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.5
passages.text: Divisis cybium latebit ovis.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.6
passages.text: Ponetur digitis tenendus ustis

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.7
passages.text: Nigra coliculus virens patella,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.8
passages.text: Algentem modo qui reliquit hortum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.9
passages.text: Et pultem niveam premens botellus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.10
passages.text: Et pallens faba cum rubente lardo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.11
passages.text: Mensae munera si voles secundae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.12
passages.text: Marcentes tibi porrigentur uvae

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.13
passages.text: Et nomen pira quae ferunt Syrorum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.14
passages.text: Et quas docta Neapolis creavit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.15
passages.text: Lento castaneae vapore tostae:

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.16
passages.text: Vinum tu facies bonum bibendo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.17
passages.text: Post haec omnia forte si movebit

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.18
passages.text: Bacchus quam solet esuritionem,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.19
passages.text: Succurrent tibi nobiles olivae,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.20
passages.text: Piceni modo quas tulere rami,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.21
passages.text: Et fervens cicer et tepens lupinus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.22
passages.text: Parva est cenula—quis potest negare?—,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.23
passages.text: Sed finges nihil audiesve fictum

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.24
passages.text: Et voltu placidus tuo recumbes;

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.25
passages.text: Nec crassum dominus leget volumen,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.26
passages.text: Nec de Gadibus inprobis puellae

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.27
passages.text: Vibrabunt sine fine prurientes

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.28
passages.text: Lascivos docili tremore lumbos;

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.29
passages.text: Sed quod non grave sit nec infacetum,

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.30
passages.text: Parvi tibia condyli sonabit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.31
passages.text: Haec est cenula. Claudiam sequeris.

passages.label: Mart. 5.78.32
passages.text: Quam nobis cupis esse tu priorem?

passages.label: Mart. 5.79.1
passages.text: Undecies una surrexti, Zoile, cena,

passages.label: Mart. 5.79.2
passages.text: Et mutata tibi est synthesis undecies,

passages.label: Mart. 5.79.3
passages.text: Sudor inhaereret madida ne veste retentus

passages.label: Mart. 5.79.4
passages.text: Et laxam tenuis laederet aura cutem.

passages.label: Mart. 5.79.5
passages.text: Quare ego non sudo, qui tecum, Zoile, ceno?

passages.label: Mart. 5.79.6
passages.text: Frigus enim magnum synthesis una facit.

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.1
passages.text: Non totam mihi, si vacabis, horam,

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.2
passages.text: Dones et licet inputes, Severe,

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.3
passages.text: Dum nostras legis exigisque nugas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.4
passages.text: 'Durum est perdere ferias': rogamus,

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.5
passages.text: Iacturam patiaris hanc ferasque.

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.6
passages.text: Quod si legeris ista cum diserto

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.7
passages.text: —Sed numquid sumus inprobi?—Secundo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.8
passages.text: Plus multo tibi debiturus hic est,

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.9
passages.text: Quam debet domino suo, libellus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.10
passages.text: Nam securus erit, nec inquieta

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.11
passages.text: Lassi marmora Sisyphi videbit,

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.12
passages.text: Quem censoria cum meo Severo

passages.label: Mart. 5.80.13
passages.text: Docti lima momorderit Secundi.

passages.label: Mart. 5.81.1
passages.text: Semper pauper eris, si pauper es, Aemiliane.

passages.label: Mart. 5.81.2
passages.text: Dantur opes nullis nunc nisi divitibus.

passages.label: Mart. 5.82.1
passages.text: Quid promittebas mihi milia, Gaure, ducenta,

passages.label: Mart. 5.82.2
passages.text: Si dare non poteras milia, Gaure, decem?

passages.label: Mart. 5.82.3
passages.text: An potes et non vis? Rogo, non est turpius istud?

passages.label: Mart. 5.82.4
passages.text: I, tibi dispereas, Gaure: pusillus homo es.

passages.label: Mart. 5.83.1
passages.text: Insequeris, fugio; fugis, insequor; haec mihi mens est:

passages.label: Mart. 5.83.2
passages.text: Velle tuum nolo, Dindyme, nolle volo.

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.1
passages.text: Iam tristis nucibus puer relictis

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.2
passages.text: Clamoso revocatur a magistro,

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.3
passages.text: Et blando male proditus fritillo,

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.4
passages.text: Arcana modo raptus e popina,

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.5
passages.text: Aedilem rogat udus aleator.

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.6
passages.text: Saturnalia transiere tota,

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.7
passages.text: Nec munuscula parva nec minora

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.8
passages.text: Misisti mihi, Galla, quam solebas.

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.9
passages.text: Sane sic abeat meus December:

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.10
passages.text: Scis certe, puto, vestra iam venire

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.11
passages.text: Saturnalia, Martias Kalendas;

passages.label: Mart. 5.84.12
passages.text: Tunc reddam tibi, Galla, quod dedisti.
